subtitle.en: Ignacio's better half got into UC Davis, so the family is moving to Davis, closer to the Sierra.
subtitle.zh: 另一半被 UC Davis 录取，一家人要搬去 Davis，那里离内华达山脉也更近。

translator.note: 源文只有一段，标题为译者所加。

blocks.en: My better half has been accepted to UC Davis, and we’ll be moving there in the next few days. We are pretty excited; I think Davis will be a better place to raise our son. It’s also closer to the Sierra, so I’ll have the chance to spend more time in the backcountry.
blocks.zh: 我的另一半被 UC Davis 录取了，接下来几天我们就要搬过去。我们挺兴奋的；我觉得 Davis 会是个更适合养孩子的地方。那里离内华达山脉也更近，我就有机会多去几趟深山野外了。
